entities.summary: Third Republic, a political institution in France during Nineteenth-Century France (1870–1914). Grew from Franco-Prussian War and loss of Alsace-Lorraine and Second Empire & Colonial Expansion. Led to the emergence of Dreyfus Affair polarises French society and Battle of Verdun – 'Ils ne passeront pas'.
